address: Censu Xerri, Tigné Point, Sliema, SLM 3190, Malta
bio: This restaurant boasts one of the most spectacular views of Malta: we suggest booking a table on the terrace (enclosed and heated in winter), which commands a knockout panorama of Valletta by night. The kitchen rolls out a wide assortment of meat and fish, underscored by a distinct fondness for grilled recipes....
